主要内容: CREDICORP LTD announced on September 25, 2019, that its Board of Directors unanimously approved a cash dividend of PEN755,058,536.00 for 94,382,317 outstanding shares, equivalent to PEN8.0000 per share. The dividend will be paid on November 22, 2019, to shareholders of record on October 23, 2019, in US Dollars based on the weighted exchange rate from the Peruvian Superintendencia de Banca, Seguros y AFP for transactions on November 20, 2019. The amount will be rounded up to four decimals. The decision was made in accordance with the Company’s Bye-Laws and Retained Earnings 2019 and freely available Optional Reserves.
